definition: The task of matching a mentioned entity in text to its corresponding entry in a structured knowledge base, resolving ambiguity between entities that share the same name.
details: Entity linking builds on entity extraction by connecting recognized entity mentions to a canonical, disambiguated identity, which is important for tasks like building accurate knowledge graphs from text.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. Here is the short version: The task of matching a mentioned entity in text to its corresponding entry in a structured knowledge base, resolving ambiguity between entities that share the same name. The part that makes it sing: Entity linking builds on entity extraction by connecting recognized entity mentions to a canonical, disambiguated identity, which is important for tasks like building accurate knowledge graphs from text. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. And that is Named Entity Linking — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
